title: Results – TCS London Marathon
claims: The official results page links to results.tcslondonmarathon.com/2026/ for the 2026 TCS London Marathon.
The results page offers event certificates and a process to request a time adjustment.
The results page notes that mass-event participants are not competing against one another and that placings or rankings are provided for comparison only.
